Package domain

Class FakeBall

java.lang.Object
domain.Entity
domain.FakeBall
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class FakeBall extends Entity
Fake ball of the Illusion shot. It looks and bounces like the real one, but it does not score or hit anybody, and it disappears when its time is over.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
